title: 國立政治大學暨國家圖書館學位論文(紙本)延後公開申請書
text:
國立政治大學暨國家圖書館學位論文(紙本)延後公開申請書
Application for Postponement of Public Disclosure of Print Thesis/Dissertation
2026.08
National Chengchi University and National Central Library
【說 明 Notes】
1. 依教育部107年12月5日臺教高(二)字第1070210758號函、109年3月13日臺教高通字第1090027810號函及
112年2月14日臺教高(二)字第1122200197號函，114年6月4日臺教高通字第1142201506號函，請據實填寫
本申請書並檢附證明文件，缺項或簽章不全者，恕不受理。
Please ensure that application forms and all supporting documents have been correctly completed and signed.
Incomplete or unsigned documents will not be accepted.
2. 本申請書一式3份，免裝訂於紙本論文內頁。辦理離校流程時，請將申請書3份、證明文件3份，併同2本紙
本論文繳交至圖書館流通櫃檯。
Three original application forms shall be included (but not bound) respectively within the thesis. When completing
school-leaving procedures, three application forms and all supporting documents should be submitted alongside the
thesis to the NCCU Library circulation desk.
